purpose: Teach: 年長/憤り/カンタン/逝っ/ねらっ/まっか/他界/対極

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが年長のご親戚と話されてたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was having a conversation with one of the older relatives earlier.
lines.style: Soft, observational. Gentle opening. Pace unhurried, as if sharing a small, tender detail. Warm without insistence. A moment of noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、不当ないじめに憤りを感じるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I felt really angry about what happened. It wasn't fair.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Direct but not aggressive. The careful sincerity of a child who has thought about something and wants to be understood. Small pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが算数をカンタンに教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad explained the math to you so gently, didn't he.
lines.style: Warm recognition. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing something good about someone he cares for. Unhurried, affirming tone. Trailing slightly on the period.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんが逝ってしまわれて悲しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm still sad that Grandpa is gone.
lines.style: Quiet, sustained sadness. Not performed — genuine and steady. A child holding something difficult without needing comfort yet, just acknowledgment. Soft throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが鳥をねらって写真撮られたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad got a really nice photo of a bird he was trying to capture.
lines.style: Pleased and genuine. A little brightness in the voice. Sharing something that delighted someone you care about. Light and present, not forced.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、走って顔がまっかになっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran around so much my face turned bright red.
lines.style: Self-aware, slightly embarrassed humor. A child noticing something absurd about himself. Small laugh underneath. Quick delivery, a little breathless, like he's still feeling the effect.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんが他界された日も心に残ってるわ
lines.en: Sho, the day your grandfather passed away is still in my heart.
lines.style: Quiet depth. Slow, intentional pace. A tender, careful acknowledgment of shared grief. Sustained and gentle, like tending to something fragile. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとは対極の好みなんだ
lines.en: Mei-sis, my tastes are kind of the opposite of Dad's, you know.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wry. A moment of self-discovery without judgment. Conversational and mildly amused at the realization. Trailing off gently, inviting understanding rather than explanation.
